fields.FIR_Description: A oral complaint dated 2025-08-10 states that the owner of Green Leaf Stores reported repeated demands for weekly payments of Rs. 4,500 from persons visiting the premises near Vaigai Layout Market Road in Tiruppur, on 2025-08-10 around 20:30 hrs. Sanjay Prakash reported the matter orally at Tiruppur North PS; the contact number given was 9000000462. The complainant is associated with the business Green Leaf Stores. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. The complainant could not identify the person involved. A car bearing the number TN-58-YY-1037 was seen leaving the area. An unidentified associate was also mentioned by the complainant. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Payment demands reportedly made with veiled threats.
fields.Keywords: extortion, business, market road, car, evening, CCTV
